I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

[h1] REVIEW [/h1]
[b] Pixel Puzzles Junior [/b] is a casual, puzzle game.
[h3] STORY [/h3]
There is no story, background, or setup to the game.
[h3] GAMEPLAY[/h3]
All of the puzzles follow traditional puzzle building mechanics. The music and atmosphere are set to the theme of the puzzles.  All of the puzzle pieces float around in the side panels and you can place them or move them as needed. The game has a button for displaying the pictures or puzzle piece outline to compare with while building the puzzles. Each puzzle has 5 levels of difficulty; 9, 20, 30, 42, and 56 pieces respectively. This puzzle set is meant for a younger audience so there is little challenge for puzzle masters. There are 50 puzzles with 5 levels of difficulty making 250 puzzles to solve.
[h3] PLAYTIME [/h3]
The game is not very complicated however if you like completing everything in a game it will  take some time to complete. Play time is ~8-9 hours to complete all puzzles, however all achievements can be obtained in 30 minutes to 1 hour by playing the smallest puzzle size for all puzzles. 
[h3] COMPLAINTS [/h3]
At the time of this review, 1 puzzle is broken, so there are only 249 puzzles to win.
[h3] REPLAYABILITY [/h3]
There is NO replayability on this game as there is no end game mechanics, no map metrics to try to beat, and no engrossing story to return to.
[h3] RECOMMENDATION [/h3]
I recommend this game to kids that like puzzles, and to achievement hunters.

My grandchildren (ages 4 and 5) play this game when I visit their home (on my computer). I sit down to play Pixel Puzzels Ultimate and almost immediately, they are asking me to quit so they can play Pixel Puzzels Junior. The littelest girl (age 4) uses the grid layout to help her see the piece placement. Both girls love managing the mouse and cursor to place the pieces and get the giraffe to win the game. As they progress in skill, they can progress in difficulty--what a wonderful concept for the little ones. They also love picking their favorite puzzles to put together, like a birthday cake, or a witch! They truly have lots of fun. They play for a while and then move on to other play things. I have seen their eye/hand coordination improve and mental agility and strategy of learning how to start with corner and edge pieces and how to progress with the rest of the puzzle. I don't think that children should spend hours at a computer, but a little time learning some basic skills, does help with crossover learning in other areas of their life. So, it's not all just fun and games. I approve of this game for what it allows my little grand-girls to learn.

Du haut de mon quart de siècle, je suis pourtant toujours aussi réfractaire à la difficulté. Ce défaut, raillé par d'aucuns, me pousse donc à acheter et à jouer à d'autant de jeux pensés pour les enfants. Oui, je sais. Mais cela n'est pas le pire, si seulement vous saviez ce qui a pu me passer entre les mains... Toutefois ce n'est ni l'endroit ni le moment de ressortir ces archives toutes aussi dangereuses pour ma masculinité que pour ma fierté.

Aujourd'hui, on se retrouve donc pour une petite review qui, espérons-le, ne se s'écrira pour une fois que sur un petit bloc-notes à défaut d'un parchemin de plusieurs pieds de long.

[b]Pixel Puzzles Junior[/b] est donc une part de la séquelle, bien connue des céphaloclastophiles (atchoum ! ), des Pixel Puzzles. Le jeu est très clairement orienté arcade et jeune public à contrario de ses consors. Le joueur se retrouve face à une cinquantaine de tableaux à composer et tout lui est offert. Oui, chaque bonus est utilisable à l'infini. Si vous ne voulez pas jouer le jeu, vous l'aurez donc terminé en moins de dix minutes. Amis complétionnistes, à votre portefeuille...

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1188478942

Si comme moi, vous souhaitez quand même y jouer dans les règles de l'art, vous choisirez le nombre de pièces maximum afin d'avoir la difficulté la plus ardue proposée par le jeu. Notez que même dans cette configuration, votre petite sœur de huit ans complétera un puzzle les doigts dans le nez...

Peu d'autres choses à dire, j'en ai peur. Les tableaux sont très jolis, les succès étant reliés aux puzzles, assemblez-les tous (n'est-ce pas Sacha?) et vous obtiendrez un clinquant et doré 100%. En somme, un petit jeu pour se détendre. Personnellement, j'y ai joué en écoutant des émissions politiques, c'était assez agréable. Sans être pressé, j'ai terminé le dernier puzzle au bout de quatre heures de jeu. Le seul point noir qui me vient en tête est le prix. Bienséance où te caches-tu, ma douce?

Изначально мне искренне хотелось порекомендовать эту игру.
Интересная идея паззлов с ориентацией на детей.
Возможность выбирать сложность каждого паззла, определяя количество кусочков.

Но уже через несколько завершённых паззлов стало ясно, что эту игру я не стал бы давать детям ни под каким предлогом.

Цветовая гамма не слишком яркая, почти кислотная. Я знаю, что дети лучше реагируют на яркие цвета, чем спокойные/блеклые/тёмные/... , но тут явный перебор. Глаза устают и с определённого момента становится сложно воспринимать интерфейс. Слишком контрастно. Это один из тех случаев, когда дизайнерские решения не получается описать иначе чем "вырвиглаз".

Выбранные картинки во многом неудачны. Детские паззлы подразумевают картинки, которые понравятся детям и достаточно просты для сбора. А здесь значительная доля картинок - психоделическое нагромождение простых изображений или просто узоров. Остальные выглядят не столько детскими, сколько просто корявыми. Хотя парочка есть приемлемых.
Я понимаю, что разработчики не могли использовать популярных персонажей из-за авторских прав и пришлось придумывать своё, но это не оправдание столь несерьёзного подхода. Рисовать можно было с большей...любовью, что ли? Для детей ведь. Да и есть же персонажи народных сказок, которых дети знают и на кого не распространяются авторские права.

В общем, игра подходит только для получения достижений. Детям же давать не советую.

PS. И это я даже не сравниваю с паззлами, которые у меня в детстве были...

"Pixel Puzzles Junior" ist ein kleines. nettes Puzzle-Spiel.

Das Spiel hat Puzzles. Also wirkliche Puzzles. Legepuzzles mit einer bestimmten Anzahl von Teilen, die man zu einem Motiv zusammenlegen muß. 

Es sind insgesamt 50 Puzzle-Motive, die insgesamt nett, bunt und kindgerecht gestaltet sind. Jedes Motiv kann man in fünf Komplexitätsgraden puzzlen. Mit 9, 20, 30, 42 oder 56 Teilen, so daß jede Altersklasse damit zurecht kommt. Für Erwachsene ist das Game nicht nur durch die geringe Teilezahl, sondern auch durch die zu simplen Motive keine Herausforderung.

Die Musik ist zwar an sich ganz kindlich nett und fröhlich, wird aber durch ständiges Geloope nach kürzester Zeit extrem anstrengend.

Die Mechaniken funktionieren, die Teile lassen sich mit der Maus gut greifen und ablegen. "Pixel Puzzles Junior" macht nicht viel, aber das, was es macht, macht es gut.

I am a big Pixel Puzzles Fan myself and although I am not a Junior I did get this game for myself whilst it is on sale (0,99€) and I must say I am actually pleasntly surprised.

I originally thought I will be having easy puzzles in the beginning like other Stand-alone Pixel Puzzle Games which get harder over time. But to my Surprise every Puzzle comes with 5 Difficulties. 

The Difficulties for each Puzzle is made via more Puzzle Pieces but they are also made smaller which is great for Kids of different Ages.

The different Puzzle Sizes are:
~ 09
~ 20
~ 30
~ 42
~ 56

Although I myself did kinda rush through this game at the easiest difficulty for easy achievements. I do believe this Game is great for children of different ages.

The Pictures included lots of cute and different things which are all drawn very colourful.

So whilst completing all 50 Puzzles on the easiest difficulty will take you only about 25 minutes, I do believe that if you have a determined child that likes to do all the other difficulties too you will get alot more hours out of it then me.

Do I recommend this game? YES

I recommend this Game to any Achievement / Perfect Game Hunter, Puzzle Fan and to children from age 3-13.
